description: This Java class defines an Android ListActivity that displays a list of strings, highlights the last clicked item, and maintains selection state using choice mode and item checked states.

classes.name: List17
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that highlights the last selected list item with support for single-choice selection mode.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the list adapter with string data, enables text filtering, configures choice mode, and sets the initial checked item.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks to update which item is marked as selected.
